she had been unable to write with her right hand

For all practical purposes, as far as I can see, she had lost the use of her right hand and arm
The Plaintiff suffered a 32% impairment of the whole person and is now significantly disabled.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: The restriction in the use of her right arm and hand was such that she had been unable to write with her right hand and what is worse is that she could not use her right hand to pick up chopsticks and her normal meals in the way she used to. She is now reduced to having to use her left hand for her meals, by the use of a spoon rather than chopsticks, because she could not handle the use of chopsticks with her left hand.

I can now turn to the assessment of damages. In these circumstances, it comes as no surprise to me when I was told and the evidence shows that she had tried to find work and could not. No one would or could possibly employ an one-armed dishwasher. She has not had any employment since the accident.

comparable_cases.injury_description: in relation to that second category the bracket figure should be, in relation to pain, suffering and loss of amenities, $335,000 to $415,000
